svg.title: 05 Covariance Matrix
svg.desc: Plot: 2D covariance of robot x and y position. Covariance matrix Sigma has sigma x squared equals 4.0, sigma y squared equals 3.0, and sigma x y equals sigma y x equals 2.5. A tilted 1-sigma ellipse is centered on the mean at (5, 5). Its long axis runs diagonally up-right, showing positive x-y correlation. Horizontal and vertical arrows mark sigma x and sigma y. A red arrow, square root of lambda 1 times v 1, marks the major axis along the tilt. A perpendicular green arrow, square root of lambda 2 times v 2, marks the minor axis.
